description: This Java class 'BaseCalculatedFieldService' implements the 'CalculatedFieldService' interface, providing CRUD operations and business logic for managing 'CalculatedField' entities within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for saving, finding, deleting, and filtering calculated fields, as well as handling related entity references and event publishing.
